exposure: Maternal Hb levels during the third trimester
Maternal mild anemia (Hb ≤ 11 g/dl) in the third trimester of pregnancy
finding: Maternal mild anemia in the third trimester of pregnancy was associated with higher birth weight in female newborns and a higher rate of emergency cesarean section, particularly when the newborn was male.
mod_finding: Anemic women had a significantly higher rate of emergency cesarean section, particularly when the newborn was male.
